decisions.reason: The consumer superfood drink sits far from the firm's engineering core and has not been visible on the website since 2018, which signals results below aspiration, so problemistic search would send its resources back to the core technology ventures.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and serve existing plant customers, so the firm would keep them despite little recent web presence.

As a flagship that builds on the core business, the waste-oil plant remains central to the firm's aspirations, and the R&D slack of a hiring firm allows it to carry the product through uncertain results.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a strategic flagship tied to the firm's mission, and its long development horizon justifies carrying it with slack, although its weak visibility raises some risk.
